claims: NASA launched the Artemis II mission on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
Artemis II liftoff occurred at 6:35:12 p.m. ET (2235 GMT).
Artemis II launched from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
The Artemis II mission duration is 10 days, concluding with a splashdown.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis II mission sends four astronauts on a 10-day journey around the Moon.
The rocket for the Artemis II mission successfully launched.
Booster separation for the Artemis II mission occurred at 6:37 p.m. ET.
Orbit was achieved for the Artemis II mission at 6:44 p.m. ET.
The Artemis II crew includes Reid Wiseman (NASA).
The Artemis II crew includes Victor Glover (NASA).
The Artemis II crew includes Christina Koch (NASA).
The Artemis II crew includes Jeremy Hansen (CSA).
